item.name: 🔗 Create Recipient

request.description:
Retrieve the recipient's customer profile and identify recipient identifiers for subsequent requests.

Saves `recipient_user_email_address`, `recipient_user_host_user_id`, `recipient_user_pass_code` to the environment.

```
GET /v1/customers/{{recipient_user_login_id}}?userIdType=LOGIN_ID
```

Retrieve the recipient's accounts and identify the recipient account number and type.

Saves `recipient_user_account_number`, `recipient_user_account_type` to the environment.

```
GET /v1/accounts?hostUserId={{recipient_user_host_user_id}}
```

Create a transfer recipient for the authenticated user.

```
POST /v1/recipients?hostUserId={{retail_user_host_user_id}}
```

item.description:
## 🔄 Retail User – Create Recipient Flow

| **Step** | Request Name | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Generate Access Token | Obtain an access token using client credentials to authorize API requests. |
| 2 | Search for Recipient Profile | (Optional) Retrieve recipient profile information, such as member number, passcode (first 3 characters of the recipient's last name), and email address. |
| 3 | Search for Recipient Account ID | (Optional) Retrieve recipient account information, such as account number and account type. |
| 4 | Create Recipient | Create a new recipient using the account information and recipient details. |

item.name: 🔗 Validate Recipient

request.description:
Retrieve the user's accounts and identify an account ID for subsequent requests.

Saves `retail_user_account_id` to the environment.

```
GET /v1/accounts?hostUserId={{retail_user_host_user_id}}
```

Retrieve the recipient's customer profile and identify recipient identifiers for subsequent requests.

Saves `recipient_user_email_address`, `recipient_user_host_user_id`, `recipient_user_pass_code` to the environment.

```
GET /v1/customers/{{recipient_user_login_id}}?userIdType=LOGIN_ID
```

Retrieve the recipient's accounts and identify the recipient account number and type.

Saves `recipient_user_account_number`, `recipient_user_account_type` to the environment.

```
GET /v1/accounts?hostUserId={{recipient_user_host_user_id}}
```

Create and validate a transfer recipient in a single request (`validate=true`).

```
POST /v1/recipients?hostUserId={{retail_user_host_user_id}}&validate=true&fromAccountId={{retail_user_account_id}}
```

item.description:
## 🔄 Retail User – Validate Recipient Flow

| **Step** | Request Name | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Generate Access Token | Obtain an access token using client credentials to authorize API requests. |
| 2 | Search for Account ID | (Optional) Use this step to find the retail user's account ID if it is not already known. |
| 3 | Search for Recipient Profile | (Optional) Retrieve recipient profile information, such as member number, passcode (first 3 characters of the recipient's last name), and email address. |
| 4 | Search for Recipient Account ID | (Optional) Retrieve recipient account information, such as account number and account type. |
| 5 | Validate Recipient | Validate the newly created recipient to ensure the recipient information is accurate and eligible for use. |
